author: Sandy Swanson
text:
We have used Alberta Septic in our different residences over the years and they are the very best!  We were referred to them by another very satisfied customer and could not have been happier.
Daley is AWESOME and so extremely knowledgeable- he really knows what he is doing - super great guy, too!  Awesome business - very responsive and helpful.  We HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

author: Kelsey Owen
text: Daley and his team are seriously 10/10! You can tell it’s a family-owned business by how friendly and caring they are. They treat their customers like family and are honest about the work you actually need. I can’t recommend them enough.

author: Laura Ford
text:
As a real estate broker for over 22 years, Alberta Septic has been my go-to septic company for most of my career. Their team consistently demonstrates integrity, professionalism, and a genuine commitment to helping homeowners understand their septic systems.

What I appreciate most is that they never try to nickel and dime my clients for unnecessary work like many other companies do. They are honest, thorough, and always go above and beyond to take great care of the people I send their way.

Alberta Septic is family owned, and it truly shows. They treat every client with respect and never like just another transaction. I recommend them with complete confidence.

author: Daniel Abbott
text: We recently bought our first house on septic and are so glad the previous owner recommended Alberta Septic. We were nervous about the process of pumping, and a technician came out who actually remembered the previous owner and took a look. As it was, he suggested we didn't actually need service at this time. I really appreciate the long relationship Alberta Septic has with its customers that builds this kind of trust, as well as the judgment of if service is actually needed or not. They're not just trying to sell you something quickly. Thank you!

author: Jo Hall
text:
In King County house sellers are required to have their septic tank system inspected by a King County licensed on-site system maintainer (OSM). We scheduled an inspection with Alberta because their website states that they have licensed OSMs preform the inspections. They sent Daley Paris, who is not a licensed OSM, based on King County's list of OSMs. We looked into his qualifications because he was very high pressure to schedule work to be done by Alberta immediately.
To us it raises serious concerns for a company to send out an unlicensed employee who presented himself more like a salesman than an inspector. We then had the inspection done by a company that sent a licensed OSM to preform the inspection.
When the report was submitted by Alberta it was signed by Pete Couty who is a licensed OSM, but Pete Couty did not do the inspection or even come to the property
